content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Foreign Languages Centre Language modules Arabic Arabic Knowledge of the general language Arabic can be acquired at the Foreign Languages Center (basic level 1, CEFR: A1). No previous knowledge is required to start this course. The course concludes with a module examination; 4 credit points are awarded if the course is passed. Head of Language Team - Other Languages Stephen Mortimer +49 30 5019-2652 Stephen.Mortimer@HTW-Berlin.de English as a foreign language Associate Lecturer Neil Belakhdar belakhd@htw-berlin.de
